Subject: Brightline onboarding: access controls bridge plan (SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist)

Hi Allyson / Tom —

Thanks again for the kickoff today. Per our discussion, I’m opening this thread to coordinate the access-control workstreams we’ll own between Brightline and Redwood: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist, and service-account guidance / org policies. Goal is to have a production-ready access configuration and test cutover window by the end of next week.

High-level asks from Brightline before our first config sprint:
- SAML metadata (entityID, ACS, cert)
- SCIM base URL + token for staging (we can accept short-lived token)
- Source IP ranges for allowlist and expected egress ranges
- Any org-level provisioning rules (attributes mapping, groups -> roles)

Ben & Marissa — can you propose a 3-step handoff plan (prep / config / validation) and own the config runbook? I’ve attached a short bridge plan draft (MAP) that we can update in-line.

Allyson — suggest a 60-90 minute technical working session with your engineers tomorrow or Friday so we can exchange metadata and validate assertions. Please indicate availability and any constraints.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Attachment: access-bridgeplan-MAP-20280314.pdf (PDF, 480KB)

Subject: Re: Brightline onboarding: access controls bridge plan (SSO / SCIM / IP allowlist)

Thanks Monica — outlining the practical handoff steps below. I’ll own the config runbook and coordinate with Neha for SCIM edge cases.

Proposed 3-step plan (approx timeline):
1) Prep (today–tomorrow) — collect metadata + create staging tenants
   - Deliverables: SAML metadata file, SCIM staging token, IP list (CSV)
   - Internal owners: Ben (runtime config), Neha (SCIM mappings)
2) Config (scheduled session) — exchange metadata; apply SSO config; enable SCIM in staging
   - Deliverables: SAML assertion test, SCIM provisioning smoke test (create user, sync group)
   - Suggested window: 2-hour technical session; we’ll do step-by-step with your engineer
3) Validation & cutover (post-config 24–72 hrs) — production switch & monitoring
   - Deliverables: cutover checklist sign-off, rollback steps, token rotation cadence

Edge notes:
- We recommend SHA-256 certs and XML metadata upload into our Console. If Brightline prefers metadata URL, we can ingest it but will ask for cert rotation window.
- For SCIM, we support PATCH / bulk operations. Neha, I’ll loop you for attribute mapping: firstName/lastName/email -> displayName, and group->role translation.

Attachments: scim-schema-v2.json (schema), sample-mapping.csv (CSV stub)

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Dedicated
Attachment: scim-schema-v2.json (JSON, 12KB)

Availability:
